# GSAP

`gsap.min.js`: GSAP 3.13.0, bundled locally for the Stage 3 envelope-and-letter timeline. No plugins are required. The rose sequence retains its original native animation loop.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/greensock/GSAP/3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js
